xporbtweaks.title: Experience Orb Tweaks
xporbtweaks.option.mod_enabled.desc: Toggles the mod on or off. Experience orbs then look exactly like vanilla.
xporbtweaks.option.render_orbs.desc: Draw experience orbs at all. Turning this off hides them completely, shadow included.
xporbtweaks.option.glow.desc: Extra light the orb emits onto itself, so it stays visible in the dark. Vanilla is 7.
xporbtweaks.option.scale.desc: Size of the orb. Vanilla is 0.30.
xporbtweaks.option.scale_shadow.desc: Scale the shadow along with the orb. Off keeps the vanilla shadow size.
xporbtweaks.option.should_pulse.desc: Fade back and forth between Color and Pulse Color. Off shows Color only.
xporbtweaks.option.pulse_speed.desc: How fast the two colors fade into each other. 10 is the vanilla speed.
xporbtweaks.option.color.desc: Base color of the orb. The alpha channel is its opacity — vanilla is 80 (half transparent).
xporbtweaks.option.pulse_color.desc: The color the orb fades towards while pulsing. Set it to the same value as Color for a solid orb.
xporbtweaks.option.rainbow.desc: Cycle the orb through the full color wheel. Overrides Color and Pulse Color.
xporbtweaks.option.rainbow_opacity.desc: Opacity used while Rainbow is on. 255 is fully solid.
xporbtweaks.option.rainbow_speed.desc: How fast the rainbow cycles. 10 is roughly one full turn every five seconds.
xporbtweaks.option.value_scale.desc: Make orbs carrying more XP physically bigger. Vanilla stops growing them at 2477 XP, so a merged clump of 50000 looks the same as one of 2477. Needs Clumps (or any merging mod) to really show.
xporbtweaks.option.value_scale_max.desc: How much bigger the largest orb gets. 2.0 means double size at Max Value.
xporbtweaks.option.value_color.desc: Blend the orb towards High Value Color the more XP it carries. Lets you tell a big clump from a small one at a glance.
xporbtweaks.option.value_color_high.desc: The color an orb reaches at Max Value. The alpha channel blends in too.
xporbtweaks.option.value_max.desc: The XP amount that counts as the top of the scale. 2477 is vanilla's cap; raise it if Clumps regularly builds bigger orbs. The scale is logarithmic.
